stem: ![](asset:P000204-stem-1)Three projectiles A, B and C are thrown from the same point in the same plane. Their trajectories are shown in the figure. Which of the following statement is true?

options.A: The time of flight is the same for all the three
options.B: The launch speed is largest for particle C
options.C: The horizontal velocity component is largest for particle C

assets.alt: Three projectile paths from O reaching the same maximum height, shown by a dashed line, and landing at A, B and C at increasing distances.
